rules.sentence: Chronic or severe tinea pedis can result in lymphangitis, characterized by the appearance of red streaks extending from the affected area and swelling and tenderness of the lymphatic vessels.
This can lead to allergic contact dermatitis, characterized by redness, itching, and a rash at the application site.
Some individuals may experience a local allergic reaction to antifungal medications or other topical treatments for tinea pedis.
